name: shop_keeper
notes: faithful by delegation, TSV row corrected 2026-11-20: C assigns the special to every .shp keeper at boot (src/shop.c:1237) and it routes steal/buy/sell/value/list to shopping_* (src/shop.c:971-1000), reached via the interpreter's room-mob spec loop (src/interpreter.c:1452-1457). Go carries all five behaviours on both lanes: player lane recovers the boot-time keeper assignment and dispatches the special, then falls through to cmdBuy/cmdSell/cmdList/cmdValue, which port shopping_buy/sell/list/value (pkg/session/commands.go:1424-1444; pkg/session/shop_cmds.go:365-554); NPC lane specShopKeeperActor + shop_npc.go ports the same shopping_* for mobile actors (pkg/game/actor_specials_shop.go:43-79). Witnessed: docs/fidelity/depth/shop.tsv — 8 oracle-green rows (shop-stack-list-live, shop-live-inventory-gate/control/filters, shop-partial-count/weight, shop-finite-stock-trade-depth, shop-switched-tell-depth) + 6 unit-green rows (R1/R5e/R5g).

notes: Decision for Zach: keep (consistent with the 25 peer unassigned specials, unit-proven) or delete the Go path. Recommendation: keep — Go ported a C-defined special without inventing dispatch; unlike silken missile, no player can reach what C never shipped, and the direct-call unit test pins the bytes (R5h).

name: turn_undead
notes: settled 2026-11-20 under Zach's keep-and-fix ruling: unassigned both sides (declared src/spec_assign.c:525, no ASSIGNOBJ; ObjSpecAssign has no entry), so the proof is a direct call, not the census. Both first differences fixed: the special is now an object-aware handler in ObjSpecRegistry (the moon_gate pattern, pkg/game/spec_procs3.go), so it receives the *ObjectInstance — C's isname(argument, obj->name) gate (src/spec_procs3.c:553) is enforced via cIsName against the object's keywords, and the act line prints $p = OBJS(obj), the short description (src/spec_procs3.c:555-556), via Act instead of the hardcoded "the object". use/rooms/exits/!cmd arms unchanged. R5h revert proof: restoring either old behavior turns the test red. Still unassigned by design — no object or world file was touched.
